summary: Tested TelePulse proxy feature end-to-end. Backend proxy endpoints (load/list/delete/test/assign/unassign/coverage/clear) fully working: 10/10 pytest cases pass, including real proxy test against 74.81.81.81:823 and bogus-proxy 400. Frontend Proxy Manager UI loads, accepts paste input, loads proxies, updates coverage (156/156), assigns/unassigns/clears correctly, and Accounts cards show 'direct (no proxy)' after unassign. Cleaned up: all proxies unassigned and cleared, accounts left in original state.

ui_bugs.issue: testFirst() calls api.testProxy() with only {proxy_type, host, port, username} — the password is NOT included because GET /api/proxies masks it. For any auth-required proxy (like the real test proxy) this always returns 400 ('Proxy test failed'). Backend endpoint POST /api/proxies/test itself works when password is supplied (verified in pytest). Fix: either (a) add a dedicated backend endpoint POST /api/proxies/{id}/test that looks up the stored password server-side, or (b) return password to the client (not recommended). Recommended: (a).

action_items: Fix Test First flow: add backend route POST /api/proxies/{id}/test that reads the stored password and calls tg.test_proxy, then update ProxyManager.testFirst to call it. Current implementation silently drops the password.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_accounts excludes 'proxy' but returns whole doc including proxy_label — good.
assign_proxies iterates all accounts sequentially with disconnect_client — for 156 accounts this is fine but could be parallelized.
proxy_coverage counts accounts_with_proxy via {"proxy": {"$exists": true}} — after unassign we $unset proxy, so this works correctly.
parse_proxy_line correctly handles the four documented formats; verified with mixed list.
test_proxy uses python_socks Proxy with 15s timeout — good.
Frontend ProxyManager Test First bug (see above) — password dropped.
seed_data_creation: None persisted — all test proxies cleared, all accounts unassigned.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully verified with /app/backend/tests/test_proxies.py (10 passing). Only outstanding issue: Test First button on Proxy Manager — password isn't sent because list endpoint masks it. Backend test endpoint requires password. After main agent fixes, retest by clicking Test First on any loaded auth-required proxy and expect success toast.
rca of the issue: GET /api/proxies intentionally strips password (good security). ProxyManager.jsx testFirst() forwards only the fields present in the masked list response and posts them to POST /api/proxies/test, which then attempts to authenticate without the password → auth-required proxies return 400. RCA: missing server-side lookup by proxy id for the test action.
